# Lider Scale

> A complete sales system: pipeline, proposals signed by link, deposits collected on the spot and commission calculated on its own. See the health of your sales floor in one minute.

Sales management software by Lider Commerce. It follows every deal from the first contact to the confirmed payment: pipeline, meetings, proposals signed by link, deposits, receivables and automatic commission. Available in English, Spanish and Portuguese.

## Pages
- [English](https://liderscale.com/en/): main page in English
- [Espanol](https://liderscale.com/es/): main page in Spanish
- [Portugues](https://liderscale.com/): main page in Portuguese

## Pricing
- Onboarding, one time: R$ 2.000 / US$ 449 / € 399
- Monthly, up to 4 users: R$ 1.500 / US$ 349 / € 299
- Additional user, per month: R$ 200 / US$ 49 / € 39

## How a deal flows
1. The lead arrives and already has an owner
2. The meeting leaves the chat and becomes a commitment
3. The proposal is ready inside the meeting
4. The client accepts and signs by link
5. The deposit lands before you leave the room
6. The project opens and the commission is calculated
